verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an MCP server that lets external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) connect INTO Bolna to manage agents/calls (bolna-docs-17, bolna-docs-25, bolna-probe-3) — this is the reverse direction from the story, which asks whether the voice agent itself can consume external MCP servers as tool sources mid-call. The tools-tab docs only mention 'ready-to-use tools' (bolna-docs-31) with no mention of MCP-based tool ingestion for the voice agent's function-calling.
